title: A background grandchild of a finished check is stopped
notes: The grandchild sleeps 20 s, so a non-conformant implementation leaves it behind only briefly.

steps.sh: p=$(cat build/grandchild.pid) || exit 1; i=0; while kill -0 "$p" 2>/dev/null; do i=$((i+1)); if [ $i -gt 10 ]; then kill -9 "$p" 2>/dev/null; echo "pid $p still alive"; exit 1; fi; sleep 0.1; done; exit 0
